t: You're on Bruton Street, in Mayfair. The most famous birth here is Queen Elizabeth the Second, born at number seventeen in 1926. The fashion designer Norman Hartnell lived at number twenty-six for forty-four years. Several other notable people were born on this street too. Lady Mary Coke, whose private letters and journal were published long after her death, was one. Admiral Beauchamp Seymour, who commanded the Mediterranean Fleet in the early 1880s, was another. So was Diana Cooper, a silent film actress and well-known social figure in London and Paris.
